SELECT content_sha256, revision, status, key_id, object_key, object_sha256 FROM sessions.session_summaries
        WHERE org_id=$1 AND workspace_id=$2 AND harness=$3 AND session_id=$4 AND machine_id=$5 AND kind=$6
BEGIN
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1, 0))

SELECT revision FROM sessions.session_summaries
          WHERE org_id=$1 AND workspace_id=$2 AND harness=$3 AND session_id=$4 AND machine_id=$5 AND kind=$6

INSERT INTO sessions.session_summaries
           (org_id, workspace_id, harness, session_id, machine_id, kind, session_uuid, trace_id, revision,
            content_sha256, status, object_key, object_sha256, key_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, generated_at)
         VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7::uuid,$8::uuid,$9,$10,$11,$12,$13,$14,$15,$16, now())
         ON CONFLICT (org_id, workspace_id, harness, session_id, machine_id, kind) DO UPDATE SET
           session_uuid = coalesce(excluded.session_uuid, sessions.session_summaries.session_uuid),
           trace_id = excluded.trace_id, revision = excluded.revision, content_sha256 = excluded.content_sha256,
           status = excluded.status, object_key = excluded.object_key, object_sha256 = excluded.object_sha256,
           key_id = excluded.key_id, tokens_in = excluded.tokens_in, tokens_out = excluded.tokens_out, generated_at = now()
COMMIT

SELECT i.org_id, i.workspace_id, i.harness, i.session_id, i.machine_id, i.manifest_key,
            i.trace_id::text AS trace_id, i.revision::text AS revision, e.session_uuid::text AS session_uuid
       FROM sessions.session_index i
       LEFT JOIN sessions.session_index_ext e USING (org_id, workspace_id, harness, session_id, machine_id)
      WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.manifest_key IS NOT NULL
        -- Needs work: no row, or a ready row still under an older key (rotation).
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions.session_summaries s
                         WHERE s.org_id=i.org_id AND s.workspace_id=i.workspace_id AND s.harness=i.harness
                           AND s.session_id=i.session_id AND s.machine_id=i.machine_id AND s.kind=$1
                           AND (s.status <> 'ready' OR s.key_id = $4))
        -- Not already queued.
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions.pipeline_jobs j
                         WHERE j.stage=$2 AND NOT j.dlq AND j.org_id=i.org_id AND j.workspace_id=i.workspace_id
                           AND j.session_id=i.session_id AND j.machine_id=i.machine_id)
        -- Not dead-lettered: a permanent failure waits for a person (replay), not every sweep.
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions.pipeline_dead_letters d
                         WHERE d.stage=$2 AND d.resolved_at IS NULL AND d.org_id=i.org_id AND d.workspace_id=i.workspace_id
                           AND d.session_id=i.session_id AND d.machine_id=i.machine_id)
      ORDER BY i.indexed_at DESC NULLS LAST
      LIMIT $3

INSERT INTO sessions.pipeline_jobs (stage, work_key, trace_id, org_id, workspace_id,
                            session_id, machine_id, message, visible_at)
       SELECT m->>'stage', m->>'workKey', (m->'ctx'->>'traceId')::uuid,
              m->'ctx'->>'orgId', m->'ctx'->>'workspaceId',
              m->'ctx'->>'sessionId', m->'ctx'->>'machineId', m,
              now() + make_interval(secs => $2::integer)
         FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) AS m
